name: Deep-space dark
description: Near-black scenes with one small glowing light source (planet rim, star, portal, ring) and a lot of empty darkness.
light: single point or rim light, thin bright edge against void; cold blue-grey ambient with one warm amber accent
composition: centred or low-horizon subject, 60-80 percent negative space, tiny figures or structures against huge scale
camera_or_medium: mix of astronomy photography, matte painting and 70s-80s sci-fi illustration; sharp, no motion blur
mood: awe, silence, solitude; contemplative not heroic
texture_detail: fine star-field grain, subtle dust, crisp rock or cloud edges; instrument-panel or diagram elements allowed, sparse
